description:
Live pump.fun detection alerts with a per-alert ACO decision. Returns recent alerts from our own pump.fun/Raydium behavioral collector (1350+ alerts/day): flow multiplier, smart-buyer count and a decision per alert (WATCH_ENTER / EXIT_IF_LONG / AVOID). Not investment advice.

Args:
    minutes: lookback window (5-720)
    alert_type: optional filter — ignition | sudden_flow | pre_pump | whale_distribute | market_exit
name: get_pump_alerts
title: Pump alerts
